gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-carian: Noto Sans Carian reads as a plain sans whose terminals hang apart like open scissor blades, tidy and unfussy. Warnes stretches out above it, its flat, unswelling line tapering off before strokes meet.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-chakma: Approachable and tidy, Noto Sans Chakma packs its lowercase up toward the caps while keeping the s and c mouths open. Warnes brings the bold stretched display voice; the body just gets on with reading.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-cham: Noto Sans Cham has tall, rounded lowercase forms and open c shapes that let the eye slip right in. Noto Sans Cham makes a long stretch of text feel modern and clean, while Warnes bends its wire-like heading across each word.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Every Warnes letter looks drawn with one nib, with no thick-thin swing at all. Noto Sans Cherokee settles beneath it as a tall band of sans letters, and its e leaves a wide gap at the terminal.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-chorasmian: Noto Sans Chorasmian has curves that stop short instead of closing, with a large x-height under short ascenders. And Warnes, with horizontals as thick as its verticals, gives the pair its boldest, most expressive streak.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-coptic: Wide, wiry and bold, Warnes sets every glyph in a single-width stroke, spaced out generously. And Noto Sans Coptic follows with a dense middle zone and open s and c mouths, so the heading gets the drama and the text stays clean.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-cuneiform: Warnes has no pinched joins or swelling bowls, just smooth strokes that taper out before they touch. Noto Sans Cuneiform keeps its e open and its lowercase puffed like glass beads, which makes a long passage feel clean and contemporary.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-deseret: Noto Sans Deseret reads openly, its apertures wide and its lowercase looking high and broad on squat ascenders. Noto Sans Deseret sits under Warnes, whose curves are as thick as its straight stems and whose spacing stretches wide.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-devanagari: Fine rope seems to be laid into every Warnes letter, a constant bold line stretched out wide. And Noto Sans Devanagari answers with a compact skyline and an open-tailed g, quiet enough to let the heading talk.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-duployan: Noto Sans Duployan reads with a wide-mouthed a and oversized e and a counters, contemporary and clean. Noto Sans Duployan would carry a long passage easily, while Warnes holds one constant stroke from top to baseline above it.
